name: Mirror Rim
source:
Our unnamed protagonist struggles with their self-identity. While dreaming, they like who they see in the mirror, but the same can't be said for when they're awake.

[From [url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/mirror-rim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这位没有名字的主人公，正为自我认同而挣扎。梦中，他们喜欢镜子里映出的自己，可清醒时，却并非如此。

[摘自[url=https://westofentropy.itch.io/mirror-rim]Itch.io[/url]]
